integrity_notes: Analytic proof separates finite exact-rational checks from infinite-dimensional moment and norm assertions; literature comparison is a best-knowledge priority assessment, not an independent proof of publication novelty.
scientific_limitations: One fixed nonzero complex tap coefficient, classical Hardy H2, linear radial symbol and two monomials; pointwise threshold limits only, no rate or closed elementary formula for interior Jacobi singular values.
title: Two-scale singular-value laws for two-tap Hardy weighted compositions
